 LOCATION For this role you need to be located in Romania.
 Senior Frontend Developer (Angular) 
 We are looking for a Frontend Developer (Angular+TypeScript) to join a long-term digital product initiative and contribute to the evolution of a complex web platform.
 Job in a nutshell 
 As a Frontend Developer, you will design and deliver modern, maintainable web functionality using Angular 22 and TypeScript. You will work within an established frontend architecture, integrate platform services through HTTP APIs, manage application state, and translate product designs into accessible, high-quality interfaces. You will contribute to an existing production codebase and help maintain strong engineering, testing, and delivery standards.
 What will you be doing:
Design, develop, and maintain frontend features for the IQ Platform using Angular 22
Build reusable, responsive, and maintainable components with TypeScript, HTML, and CSS/SCSS
Implement reactive application flows using RxJS
Manage application state using NGXS
Integrate frontend functionality with REST / HTTP APIs
Contribute to frontend architecture, component design, and technical decision-making
Write and maintain automated tests using Jest and Angular TestBed
Implement UI specifications and Figma designs with attention to usability and consistency
Use Optimus UI and Angular CDK where relevant to deliver robust interface patterns
Support authentication and authorization integration with Keycloak
Contribute to localization using Angular i18n and Crowdin
Work effectively in an Nx monorepo and follow ESLint and Prettier standards
Participate in code reviews, GitHub workflows, CI/CD activities, troubleshooting, and technical documentation
 Requirements:
 Core requirements 
Strong hands-on experience with Angular 22
Strong knowledge of TypeScript, HTML, and CSS/SCSS
Experience with RxJS and reactive frontend patterns
Experience with NGXS state management
Experience integrating REST / HTTP APIs
Good understanding of frontend architecture and reusable component design
Experience with Jest and Angular TestBed
Experience with Git / GitHub, automated testing, CI/CD, architecture principles, and production codebases
 Additional experience considered an advantage 
Optimus UI and Angular CDK
Implementing designs from Figma
Keycloak integration
Angular i18n and Crowdin
Nx monorepo environments
ESLint and Prettier
 Rewards and benefits:
Opportunity to work on long-term, complex enterprise projects
Exposure to modern technologies and containerized platforms
Continuous learning and professional development opportunities
Career growth within a stable and collaborative environment
Wellbeing programs & work-life balance initiatives
Benefits platform – culture, shopping, sport, and more
Continuous learning programs and online courses
Possibility to participate in charity and eco initiatives
